title: Provider-neutral end-to-end autonomous development workflow
invariants: Every observation is bound to Coordinator task AR-0023 revision 1, one project, worktree, session, worker, and lease.
The ordered trace covers planning, execution, quality submission, oracle discussion and decision, review, merge observation, recovery, and durable reconciliation.
Recovery requires the exact checkpoint and replaces both worker and lease before resume; the old worker remains fenced.
AWQ and AWG results are attributed observations and cannot be manufactured by runtime events.
Merge and terminal observations retain merge_status not_performed and remote_verification unverified.
Durable-state and remote observations are supplied evidence only; the checker performs no mutation, network, provider, LLM, Git, CI, or review operation.

privacy.projection: bounded states, identities, statuses, and SHA-256 evidence digests only

limitations: A passing trace proves contract ordering and supplied evidence shape, not autonomous execution or agent quality.
Review, merge, hosted CI, provider execution, remote consumption, and Coordinator truth remain unverified until authoritative systems report them.
Authority lists describe accepted attribution; they do not replace Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, or UI authority.
